==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. My ghostly UFO had taken me to space, because the Were-Sharks had found the Golden Trident and taken over the village. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My Ghostly UFO resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Were-Sharks resemble humanoid sharks.) (The Golden Trident resembles a sparkling golden glowing magical trident.)
My UFO formed into a ghostly suit of armor around me, as I used my Porta spell to travel right to the Were-Shark with the Golden Trident.
I cast Ligo to bind myself to the ground, then opened a portal to space. The portal pulled in the Were-Shark, and as it was launched into space, I used Ligo again to summon the trident to me.
